kjv: hath he gotten all this glory
mine: he has gained all this wealth
note: Hebrew kavod (literally "weight") here means wealth or substance, as the context of flocks shows; "glory" suggests honour or splendour.

kjv: the rams which leaped upon the cattle
mine: the male goats that mounted the flock
note: Hebrew attudim are he-goats, not rams; the striped, speckled and spotted animals here are the goats of 30:32-35.
Hebrew teraphim were household gods or ancestral figurines (Laban calls them "my gods", v.30); "images" is vague and hides their religious and possibly inheritance-related role.
Hebrew kar haggamal is a camel's saddle or litter; "furniture" in 1611 meant harness or trappings.
